questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.topic: The man form against the sich form
questions.learningObjective: Explain the difference between 'man' and 'sich' constructions
questions.stem: Explain the difference between 'man' and 'sich' in an impersonal reflexive sentence.

answer.exemplar: 'Man' is the impersonal subject, while 'sich' is the reflexive object; together they form an impersonal reflexive construction.

questions.explanation: The subject 'man' is impersonal and the reflexive 'sich' refers back to it. Adding a dative object changes the structure.
